@Nullable IKitInventory[] getKitInventories(@NotNull

      • getSelectionItems

        java.util.Map<java.lang.Integer,org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack> getSelectionItems(@NotNull
                                                                                  @NotNull org.bukkit.entity.Player player,
                                                                                  @NotNull
                                                                                  @NotNull IKit kit)
        Get the selection items for a player for a specific kit. This will return the items that will be given to the player. If not custom inventories exist, it will return the default item on the 0 index. Otherwise, the default item will appear on 8th index.
        Parameters:
        player - to get for
        kit - to get for
        Returns:
        Map of slot to ItemStack
